Created three files:

- `src/main/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocol.java:1` — UDP-only `EndpointListener` with `GlyphBoundaryFrameSplitter(MAX_FRAME_LENGTH, '$')` plus string codecs.
- `src/main/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocolDecoder.java:1` — `@LINK` registers the session and returns null; `@GPSD` parses via `GrammarComposer`/`FieldCursor` into a `Position` (UTC date/time, `WHOLE_DEG_HEMI` coordinates, km/h→knots speed, course, altitude, `KEY_BATTERY_LEVEL`, `KEY_LOCK` = `L`, alarm added when non-empty). The R/S field is matched but not captured, following the existing archive-flag convention (`RstProtocolDecoder.java:40`, `L100ProtocolDecoder.java:75`).
- `src/test/java/org/traccar/protocol/R16hProtocolDecoderTest.java:1` — login (`assertNoOutput`) plus the sample position and a southern/western variant with a negative altitude and alarm code.

Not verified by execution: `./gradlew test --tests '*R16h*'` and a standalone regex check were both denied by the permission layer (no approval surface in this session), so the code is reviewed-by-hand only — group ordering, `FieldCursor` consumption order, and checkstyle rules (the `Header` module is disabled, so the missing license headers are fine) were checked against the sources, but nothing was compiled or run.

Also note the protocol won't listen until a `r16h.port` entry exists in `setup/traccar.xml`; you asked for three Java files only, so I left that config untouched.
